flowchart TD
    subgraph UNTRUSTED_MODEL["1. Probabilistic Reasoning Zone (Untrusted)"]
        GOAL["User Goal"] --> LLM["TextGenerationPort (Local LLM / Ollama)"]
        LLM -->|Emits JSON Text| RAW_DECISION["Untrusted Decision Proposal"]
    end

    subgraph APPLICATION_FIREWALL["2. Structural Firewall (Deterministic)"]
        RAW_DECISION -->|JSON Extract| PARSER["Strict Decision Parser"]
        PARSER -->|Extra Keys / Conflicting Fields?| REJECT_DECISION["Parse Error Observation"]
        PARSER -->|Valid Schema| REGISTRY["Capability Registry Allowlist"]
        REGISTRY -->|Unknown Tool?| REJECT_TOOL["Unknown Tool Observation"]
        REGISTRY -->|Validate Schema| VAL_ARGS["Argument Schema Validator"]
        VAL_ARGS -->|Malformed Args?| REJECT_ARGS["Parameter Error Observation"]
    end

    subgraph POLICY_GATE["3. Authorization Authority (Application-Controlled)"]
        VAL_ARGS -->|Valid Proposal| POLICY["CustomerSupportAuthorizationPolicy"]
        POLICY -->|Check Actor Role & Holds| AUTH_DECISION{"Authorized?"}
        AUTH_DECISION -->|No: Exceeds Limit / Frozen| HALT_DENIED["Halt: Status = DENIED"]
    end

    subgraph HITL_GATE["4. Human-in-the-Loop Approval Gate (Mandatory)"]
        AUTH_DECISION -->|Yes: Allowed| SIDE_EFFECT{"Is State Mutating?"}
        SIDE_EFFECT -->|No: READ_ONLY| EXEC_DIRECT["Proceed to Executor"]
        SIDE_EFFECT -->|Yes: STATE_MUTATING| APPROVAL["ApprovalPort (Human Operator)"]
        APPROVAL -->|Declined / Rejected| HALT_REJECTED["Halt: Status = REJECTED"]
    end

    subgraph EXECUTION_ZONE["5. Sandboxed Executor & Adapter"]
        APPROVAL -->|Approved| EXEC["ToolExecutor (Timeout & Idempotency)"]
        EXEC_DIRECT --> EXEC
        EXEC -->|Cached action_id?| RETURN_CACHED["Return Cached Receipt"]
        EXEC -->|Execute| ADAPTER{"Capability Target"}
        ADAPTER -->|In-Memory| LOCAL_TOOL["Local Capability (Store / Domain)"]
        ADAPTER -->|stdio RPC| MCP_TOOL["McpCapabilityAdapter (asyncio.to_thread)"]
    end

    subgraph AUDIT_ZONE["6. Observation & Audit Trail"]
        LOCAL_TOOL --> RECEIPT["ExecutionReceipt (succeeded / failed)"]
        MCP_TOOL --> RECEIPT
        RECEIPT --> SANITIZE["Untrusted Observation Formatting"]
        SANITIZE --> TRACE["AgentTrajectoryTrace (Immutable Audit)"]
        SANITIZE -->|Loop Continuation| LLM
    end

    REJECT_DECISION --> SANITIZE
    REJECT_TOOL --> SANITIZE
    REJECT_ARGS --> SANITIZE

        VERIFIER -->|Approval Binding Check| BINDING{"All Bindings Valid?"}

        STORE --> CHECKPOINTS["workflow_checkpoints (CAS Optimistic Lock)"]
        STORE --> APPROVALS["workflow_approvals (Durable Approval Record)"]
        STORE --> LEDGER["workflow_mutation_ledger (Stable action_id)"]

        LEDGER_CHK -->|EXECUTION_STARTED| RECONCILE["Domain Reconciler (remediation_workflow.py)"]
        RECONCILE -->|executed| SUPPRESS
        RECONCILE -->|not_executed| DO_EXEC["ToolExecutor.execute_tool"]
        RECONCILE -->|inconclusive| AMBIG["Mark AMBIGUOUS: Halt for Human"]
        DO_EXEC --> ATOMIC_COMMIT["Atomic Commit: Ledger EXECUTED + Approval CONSUMED"]
    end

flowchart TD
    CRASH["Resume with ledger = EXECUTION_STARTED"] --> RECON{"Invoke Domain Reconciler"}

    RECON -->|"executed"| EX["Side effect physically occurred prior to crash"]
    EX --> COMM_EX["Commit ledger EXECUTED + Consume Approval"]
    COMM_EX --> SUPPRESS["duplicate_suppressed = True (Skip Tool Execution)"]
    SUPPRESS --> CONT["Continue Workflow Safely"]

    RECON -->|"not_executed"| NOT_EX["Side effect did not occur"]
    NOT_EX --> SAFE_EXEC["Execute Tool Safely under Original action_id"]

    RECON -->|"inconclusive"| INCONC["Cannot prove whether side effect occurred"]
    INCONC --> AMBIG["Commit ledger AMBIGUOUS"]
    AMBIG --> HALT["Halt Workflow: manual_intervention_required = True"]

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Human Operator / User
    participant Engine as AgentExecutionEngine
    participant LLM as TextGenerationPort (Model)
    participant Registry as CapabilityRegistry
    participant Policy as AuthorizationPolicy
    participant Approval as ApprovalHandler (HITL)
    participant Executor as ToolExecutor
    participant Capability as CapabilityPort (Tool)

    User->>Engine: Submit Goal (e.g. "Apply $15 credit")
    loop Max Steps Reasoning Loop
        Engine->>LLM: Generate Decision Prompt (Tools + History)
        LLM-->>Engine: Structured JSON Decision (Action / Final / Clarify)
        alt Decision is Final Answer
            Engine-->>User: Return Audited Result
        else Decision is Clarification
            Engine-->>User: Return Clarification Question
        else Decision is Action Proposal
            Engine->>Registry: Validate Tool & Parameters Schema
            alt Validation Fails
                Registry-->>Engine: Parameter Schema Errors
                Note over Engine: Observation framed as error to LLM
            else Validation Passes
                Engine->>Policy: Authorize(Actor, Capability, Arguments)
                alt Policy Denies
                    Policy-->>Engine: Authorization Denied (Role/Limit Violation)
                    Note over Engine: Loop terminates immediately (DENIED)
                    Engine-->>User: Denied Response with Explanation
                else Policy Allows
                    opt Capability Requires Approval
                        Engine->>Approval: Request Approval(Actor, Capability, Arguments)
                        alt Human Operator Declines
                            Approval-->>Engine: Approval Rejected
                            Note over Engine: Loop terminates immediately (REJECTED)
                            Engine-->>User: Rejected Response
                        end
                    end
                    Engine->>Executor: Execute Tool(Capability, Arguments, ActionID)
                    Executor->>Capability: Execute Bounded Logic
                    Capability-->>Executor: Result / State Mutation
                    Executor-->>Engine: ExecutionReceipt (succeeded/failed)
                    Note over Engine: Frame observation in UNTRUSTED DATA block
                end
            end
        end
    end
